description: `plans/overview.html:1421-1428` renders phase-tree task refs from static `node.state` / `visibleText`, and those states are hardcoded in `plans/overview-data.js:1060-1062,1142,1149`. So flipping a task’s `phase` in `tasks[]` updates the command row, but **does not update the corresponding phase-tree entry** without a second manual edit in `phaseTree[]`. That breaks the promised one-entry “bookkeeper workflow” acceptance criterion.
